

PACKAGE kernel32 IS

 * 	Code only called from Forms	= Y

 * 	Include Pre-Load Procedure	= N
\*--------------------------------------------------------------*/

/*--------------------------------------------------------------*\

\*--------------------------------------------------------------*/

/*--------------------------------------------------------------*\ 
 * FUNCTION   GetComputerNameA: 
\*--------------------------------------------------------------*/

   FUNCTION  GetComputerNameA(
			aname               	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			gname               	IN OUT	PLS_INTEGER
			)  RETURN PLS_INTEGER;

/*--------------------------------------------------------------*\ 
 * The following variables form part of the standard FFIGEN
 * error handling routine.  The Error Boolean is set to
 * indicate that an error has occurred and the varchar2
 * variable holds the text of the error.
\*--------------------------------------------------------------*/

   FFI_Error     	BOOLEAN;
   FFI_Error_Text	VARCHAR2(2000);
   FFI_Error_Code	NUMBER;

END kernel32;


PACKAGE BODY kernel32 IS


-- Private Package Variables
   lh_kernel32                      	ORA_FFI.LIBHANDLETYPE;
   fh_GetComputerNameA              	ORA_FFI.FUNCHANDLETYPE;


-- Private PU Declarations
   PROCEDURE LoadLibrary;

   FUNCTION  i_GetComputerNameA(
			FunctionHandle     		IN      ORA_FFI.FUNCHANDLETYPE,
			aname                         	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			gname                         	IN OUT	PLS_INTEGER
			) RETURN PLS_INTEGER;
   PROCEDURE rg_GetComputerNameA;



-- Pragma statements which Hook the PL/SQL into the 3gl Function Call
-- *** Do Not Alter These Statements ***
   PRAGMA INTERFACE(C,i_GetComputerNameA,	11265);


-- Bodies for Private PUs
/*--------------------------------------------------------------*\ 
 * The LoadLibrary procedure attempts to load the specified
 * 3gl library file so the the functions within it can be
 * accessed.  It first of all checks to see if the Library
 * file is loaded already, and if it isn't does the load.
\*--------------------------------------------------------------*/

   PROCEDURE LoadLibrary IS
   BEGIN
	BEGIN
		lh_kernel32 := ORA_FFI.FIND_LIBRARY('kernel32.dll');
	EXCEPTION
		WHEN ORA_FFI.FFI_ERROR THEN 
			lh_kernel32 := ORA_FFI.LOAD_LIBRARY(NULL,'kernel32.dll');
	END;
   EXCEPTION
	WHEN OTHERS THEN
		-- Place the first error on the TOOL_ERR stack into the package header variables available for it.
		FFI_ERROR	:= TRUE;
		FFI_Error_Text	:= TOOL_ERR.MESSAGE;
		FFI_Error_Code	:= TOOL_ERR.CODE;
		FOR iErrors IN 1..TOOL_ERR.NERRORS LOOP
			Message('kernel32: '||TOOL_ERR.MESSAGE);
			TOOL_ERR.POP;
		END LOOP;

		TOOL_ERR.CLEAR;

   END LoadLibrary;

   PROCEDURE rg_GetComputerNameA IS
   BEGIN
	fh_GetComputerNameA := ORA_FFI.REGISTER_FUNCTION(lh_kernel32,'GetComputerNameA',ORA_FFI.C_STD);
	ORA_FFI.REGISTER_PARAMETER(fh_GetComputerNameA,ORA_FFI.C_CHAR_PTR);
	ORA_FFI.REGISTER_PARAMETER(fh_GetComputerNameA,ORA_FFI.C_LONG_PTR);
	ORA_FFI.REGISTER_RETURN(fh_GetComputerNameA,ORA_FFI.C_INT);
   EXCEPTION
	WHEN OTHERS THEN
		-- Place the first error on the TOOL_ERR stack into the package header variables available for it.
		FFI_ERROR	:= TRUE;
		FFI_Error_Text	:= TOOL_ERR.MESSAGE;
		FFI_Error_Code	:= TOOL_ERR.CODE;
		FOR iErrors IN 1..TOOL_ERR.NERRORS LOOP
			Message('kernel32: '||TOOL_ERR.MESSAGE);
			TOOL_ERR.POP;
		END LOOP;

		TOOL_ERR.CLEAR;

   END rg_GetComputerNameA;



-- Bodies for Public PUs
   FUNCTION  GetComputerNameA(
			aname               	IN OUT	VARCHAR2,
			gname               	IN OUT	PLS_INTEGER
			)  RETURN PLS_INTEGER IS
	RC                   		PLS_INTEGER;
	l_aname                       	VARCHAR2(256)	:= RPAD(SUBSTR(NVL(aname,' '),1,256),256,CHR(0));
	l_gname                       	PLS_INTEGER	:= gname;
   BEGIN

	rc := i_GetComputerNameA(
			fh_GetComputerNameA,
			l_aname,
			l_gname);
	aname                         	:= l_aname;
	gname                         	:= l_gname;
   RETURN RC;
   END GetComputerNameA;

BEGIN

	LoadLibrary;
	rg_GetComputerNameA;
END kernel32;
